compatibility_contract.canonical_v2_independence: The v0.5 JSON schema and runtime implementation remain unchanged.
laws: exportV05(importV05(x, ledger), ledger) == x for every valid v0.5 instance
importV05(exportV05(y, ledger), ledger) == y only for the v0.5-representable V2 subset or a complete ledger
ledger_preserves: complete envelope and unknown extension data
presence versus explicit null versus empty values
all opaque identifiers and enum lexemes
legacy ValidationCase.level without deriving it from abstractVVCase
legacy endpoint/tool/topic slots while V2 uses one RuntimeActionLocator

invariants.text: Dependencies are one-way: RCM may import EAST-ADL; no EAST-ADL package imports RCM.
The imported TraceableSpecification has exactly one local optional text attribute.
The four imported infrastructure marker metaclasses have no generalizations.
Satisfy targets Requirements or UseCases, never both in one relationship.
satisfiedBy excludes Requirement and RequirementContainer.
Imported EAST-ADL Extend has no condition; ConditionalExtend adds it conservatively.
An unchanged EAST-ADL UseCase may have zero RCM scenarios in the core profile.
The executable RCM profile requires exactly one main scenario per specified UseCase.
A main scenario has no variantOf reference.
Every alternative or exception scenario references exactly one main scenario.

invariants.expression: stepRelation->select(kind=sequence or kind=fork or kind=join or kind=alternative or kind=exception or kind=loop)
invariants.text: StepRelation is the single semantic source of control flow; collection order and stepNumber are display/projection data.
stepNumber is derived for display and is not a third control-flow authority.
A ParallelGroup is structural and all members are reachable between matching fork and join relations.
ScenarioStep never directly references RuntimeAction; the capability chain remains mandatory.
Every ScenarioCondition EAExpression is Boolean-typed.
ScenarioEvent combines identifiable timing-event semantics with expression semantics.
Probability is an EANumerical type with the closed range [0,1]; this is not a UML multiplicity.
Every ProbabilityValue is typed by Probability and lies in its range.
Unity-compatible EntityKind.agent is retained and exactly equivalent to Agent specialization.
Concrete performers and external Actor roles remain separate.
CapabilityUse follows the formal EAPrototype-to-EAType pattern.
Every Capability promises at least one observable Effect.
Every Effect is specified by at least one reusable, testable Assertion; an expectation is not mislabeled as evidence.
A function mapping selects exactly one real EAST-ADL type/prototype target; FAA/FDA are not invented metaclasses.
Elementary FunctionTypes have no analysis/design parts (exact EAST-ADL constraint).
FunctionConnector links exactly two FunctionPorts through instance references.
FunctionBehavior keeps both mandatory EAST-ADL attributes.
FunctionBehavior has synchronous run-to-completion execution semantics.
A behavior binding is admissible only where the bound behavior's run-to-completion semantics fit; it is never a Refine relation.
Every RuntimeBinding owns at least one ordered RuntimeAction.
Every V2 RuntimeAction has exactly one structured locator.
Locator kind is exclusive; legacy endpoint/tool/topic slots are projection fields.
ParameterBinding maps one typed use parameter to one typed runtime parameter.
The root owns exactly one exact VerificationValidation container.
ValidationCase is composed only through VerificationValidation.vvCase, never directly by the root.
Only a concrete VVCase may own VVLogs.
Only a concrete VVCase may have VVTargets.
Only a concrete VVCase may identify an abstractVVCase.

invariants.expression: (vvStimuli->notEmpty() or vvIntendedOutcome->notEmpty() or abstractVVProcedure->notEmpty()) implies isConcrete(self)
invariants.text: Stimuli, intended outcomes and abstractVVProcedure are concrete-procedure features.
Actual runtime outcomes exist only under RuntimeValidationLog/VVLog.
vvSubject and VVTarget.element have distinct roles but may coincidentally reference some of the same elements.
Verify remains a RequirementsRelationship between Requirements and VVCases/optional procedures.
Each UseCase-validation relationship has exactly one case and one UseCase and does not overload Verify.
Legacy abstract/concrete level is not uniquely derivable from abstractVVCase and must be preserved by the projection ledger.
Every valid v0.5 instance round-trips byte-semantically, including IDs, array order, null/missing distinctions and enum lexemes.
V2-to-v0.5 reverse projection is total only for the representable subset or with a complete sidecar ledger.
The v0.5 compatibility view keeps the main scenario first for existing backend selection behavior.
The two existing Agent identities and their provenance are preserved exactly.
Annex C TransitionEvent is EAElement plus BehaviorConstraintParameter, not a Timing::Event subtype.
The Annex C connection to Timing::Event is an association only.

invariants.expression: optional=true and preliminary=true and not Core.imports(AnnexCBridge)
invariants.text: Annex C mapping is optional and preliminary and creates no Core back-dependency.
Generic/VehicleFeature mapping is optional; the domain-independent Core has no automotive dependency.
Knowledge/perception/provenance support is optional and does not invalidate existing Agent instances.

invariants.expression: capabilityUse->notEmpty() and prototypeTarget->notEmpty() implies prototypeTarget.type = mappedTypeFor(capabilityUse.type)
invariants.text: A CapabilityUse-to-function-prototype mapping must use a prototype whose type matches the function type mapped for the same Capability.
An Annex C BehaviorConstraintType references at least one requirement, vehicle feature, mode, function type, function behavior, function trigger or error behavior definition.
A concrete RuntimeStimulus identifies at least one ScenarioEvent or RuntimeAction.
Agent responsibility and grounding references retain the Unity-visible zone/asset meaning.
The exact Refine.refinedBy role excludes Requirement and RequirementContainer.
An event-driven FunctionTrigger references at least one triggering port.
A time-driven FunctionTrigger has no triggering port.
A FunctionTrigger identifies either one FunctionType or one FunctionPrototype, never both.
Every triggering port is an input FunctionFlowPort.
The RCM application profile requires exactly one RequirementsModel in addition to exactly one VerificationValidation container.
An explicit CapabilityUse provider must perform the owning step and provide the referenced Capability type.
Every CapabilityUse in the executable authoring profile has exactly one explicit provider; the compatibility core remains [0..1] because legacy data cannot identify one unambiguously.

invariants.expression: not self.oclIsTypeOf(Assertion) and subject->size()=1 and expression->size()=1
invariants.text: Only concrete Assertion specializations may be instantiated, each with exactly one identifiable subject and one EAExpression.
Each structured result evaluates exactly one Assertion and records exactly one verdict.
Every runtime actual outcome contains at least one structured AssertionResult.
Every runtime target names one platform and exposes every configured RuntimeBinding through the inherited VVTarget.element role.

invariants.expression: vvSubject->forAll(s | s.oclIsKindOf(ScenarioStep) or s.oclIsKindOf(Capability) or s.oclIsKindOf(RuntimeBinding) or s.oclIsKindOf(Entity))
invariants.text: RCM ValidationCase subjects are ScenarioSteps, Capabilities, RuntimeBindings or Entities while EAST-ADL VVCase.vvSubject remains unchanged.
Both endpoints of a StepRelation belong to the same owning Scenario.

invariants.expression: memberStep->forAll(s | s.scenario = self.scenario) and memberStep->size()>=2 and boundedByReachableForkJoin(self)
invariants.text: A ParallelGroup is owned with at least two members in one Scenario, structurally between matching fork and join relations.
A control-flow probability is permitted only on alternative or exception edges.
If every alternative/exception edge of a branch carries a probability, the complete branch probabilities sum to one.
Every scene object has at most one provider at the first nonempty asset/group/zone responsibility level; no fallback follows an ambiguity.
Every scene object has an owner at some responsibility level; together INV-075 and INV-076 require exactly one deciding provider.
Each uniquely owned scene object has one native ScenarioStep-to-CapabilityUse-to-Capability-to-RuntimeBinding-to-RuntimeAction answering path and one matching chat trace projection.
Handoff references identify distinct other agents, without self-loops or duplicates.
Warn when a group or zone has several owners and any member lacks unique asset-level coverage; fully shielded shared ownership is also reported.
Report every start-agent/object pair needing more than one handoff or having no directed path; these pairs reject at runtime and do not invalidate publication.
Project and trace declare sha256-lf-v1 and a matching model digest. This is a project-level publication obligation, not a metamodel class.
